name: 여포
design: 여령기의 기수·말 골격, 머리·몸·말 비율과 도트 화풍을 그대로 기준으로 한 무수염 여포. 흑적 중갑·금색 쌍깃·방천화극·적갈색 말을 유지한다.
prompt: Rebuild Lü Bu from the v317 target using Lü Lingqi as the strict rider/horse anatomy, footprint, spacing and pixel-style reference. Exact 8x8 transparent 64-sprite atlas with idle, three walk rows, thrust strike/recovery and slash strike/recovery in E,SE,S,SW,W,NW,N,NE order. Preserve red-black armor, silver chest accents, gold double feather crest, red headband, Fangtian halberd and brown-red horse. Remove moustache, beard, goatee and stubble in every frame; keep a masculine stern clean-shaven face with thick eyebrows, narrowed eyes and angular jaw. No oversized rider, horse or feathers, extra objects, text, grid, shadow or effects.
